title: mut.multi_click_states
mutation_directive: Convert this piece from single-state (or A↔B morph) into a MULTI-CLICK CYCLE through 5 distinct visual states. Each click advances to the next state with a short cross-fade. States should be MEANINGFULLY different in form, not just palette swaps — different geometry, different motion law, or different particle distribution. Display the current state name in the bottom-right.
